cmd.ctx.floor.clean_outline.desc: Removes narrow spikes where the floor outline turns back on itself. Shows a preview first; one undo step.
outline_cleanup.title: Clean up outline
outline_cleanup.intro: The outline of this floor turns back on itself in narrow spikes: {n}. Clean-up removes them; everything else stays as it is.
outline_cleanup.legend_after: Thin line: the outline after clean-up
outline_cleanup.undo: You can undo this in one step.
outline_cleanup.none: The outline of this floor has no spikes
outline_cleanup.failed: Could not clean up the outline
outline_cleanup.changed: The outline changed since the preview; nothing was written. Check the new preview.
